limitations: This digest detects an accidental or isolated manifest edit, but does not protect against an attacker who can modify both obligations.manifest.json and obligations.digest in the same repository snapshot.

requiredFields.gateId: must exactly match the manifest gate id
requiredFields.argv: must exactly equal the gate's manifest-owned argv
requiredFields.cwd: must be the canonical repository root string: .
requiredFields.treeHash: SHA-256 computed with snapshotAlgorithm over every tracked or non-ignored untracked regular file in the Git worktree, excluding this package's receiptDirectory/**
requiredFields.artifacts: non-empty array of { path, sha256 }; every gate artifactPathPattern must match an artifact path, outputArtifactPath must name a normalized, substantive capture of concatenated stdout and stderr from a fresh re-execution, and every path must be a repository-relative regular file outside receiptDirectory with a current lowercase SHA-256

gates.obligation: vendored upstream stable schema trees match independently-frozen upstream Git subtree OIDs.
experimental schema profile generated by the pinned upstream exporter, with the no-flag run reproducing the committed stable trees.
a real spawned `gjc app-server --stdio` JSON-RPC conversation that exercises CLI launch, stdio transport, broker-child lifecycle, and provider propagation.
a provenance-bound static T3 Code startup-path extraction replayed against the implementation (protocol-contract gate; explicitly not a real-client smoke).
the actual t3.code v0.0.28 client binary driving GJC end to end, rather than a replay or hand-written protocol client.
